_comment: The ERC20 transfer circuit versions. Every listed version is a member of every ERC20 fungibility domain, so its resources are fungible with every other listed version's behind the same forwarder. Exactly one version is active: it keeps its own kind, and the backend creates its resources. Every other version is deprecated: an alias of the active one, which the backend consumes and converts. A release appends the new version as active and sets the previous one to deprecated. The active version is always the highest listed. A deprecated version leaves the list only when no resource of it exists under the label of a recorded forwarder; until then it stays, even when the protocol adapter denies its logic ref.

ERC20Resource._comment: The circuit that the legacy forwarders accept. transfer_library ships it as 2.0.0 for arm-risc0 1 and as 3.0.0-rc.2 for arm-risc0 2.

_comment_spl_token: The AnomaPay Solana transfer circuit versions, under the same rules. Its label is sha256(forwarder program id ‖ mint).
